note: North Conway is a village inside the Town of Conway. Police, roads, the transfer station and elections are run by the Town of Conway; fire protection, water and sewer in North Conway come from the North Conway Water Precinct. Checked Oct 30, 2026 from town, precinct and department pages and local news. Every item links to its source.

region.source: Redfin, Carroll County NH housing market
region.summary: Carroll County, three months ending July 2026 (Redfin): median sale price $498,538, up 6.1% from a year earlier. 116 homes sold in July, up from 110. Homes sold after 52 days on the market, compared with 51 a year earlier. For single-family homes only, North Conway Realty counted 156 county sales in the first quarter of 2026 (155 a year earlier), with an average price of $659,578 and 87 days on market, up from 62.

mount-washington-valley.note: Redfin's Conway page, the only local page with full market figures; Redfin does not say whether it covers the whole town or just Conway Village. Homes sold is August only. Redfin rates the market somewhat competitive (47 of 100) with a 97.6% sale-to-list ratio. Redfin's separate North Conway page shows only a one-month median of $646,000, up 39.0% from a year earlier, with no sales count.

notices.title: Conway Village Main Street (Route 16) project pauses for winter in November
notices.detail: Phase 2 began Sept 2 on the west side of Route 16, from the Route 16 and 113 intersection north to the Saco River bridge. The plan keeps two-way traffic throughout, with flaggers at times. The Conway Daily Sun reported that work continues through November, then pauses for winter and resumes in April 2027. The town engineer says the project is scheduled to finish by Oct 1, 2027.

source.label: Town of Conway, Town Engineer project updates

election.absentee: Absentee voting is for voters who will be out of town on Election Day, have a disability or illness that keeps them from voting in person, or have work or caregiving duties. Request a ballot from the Town Clerk with photo ID; applications are accepted up to the day before the election. Return it in person by 5 PM Monday, Nov 2, or by mail so it arrives by 5 PM on Election Day. The town posts the state request form on its Documents page.
election.sameDay: You can register at the polling place on Election Day with proof of identity, age (18 or older), U.S. citizenship and domicile. A REAL ID is not proof of citizenship.

burnPermits.text: New Hampshire requires a written permit for outdoor burning unless the ground is covered with snow. Get one from the local Forest Fire Warden or fire department, or online at NHFirePermit.com if the town takes part. You must be 18 or older.

benchmarks.note: FBI figures for 2024, the latest year with matching town, state and national numbers. Rates are offenses reported to police per 100,000 residents; Conway's figures cover the whole town (population 10,441), including North Conway. Conway draws large numbers of visitors and shoppers who aren't counted as residents, which pushes per-resident rates up. The FBI advises against ranking places on these numbers alone.
